rows.grounds: locative adverb referring to the previously mentioned place

items.question: In what form is Lord Śambhu established at that sacred location?
premises: Lord Śambhu is present at that location.
His presence is characterized as having the form of a liṅga.
The deity is described as firmly established there.
items.inference: Lord Śambhu is established at that place in the form of a liṅga.
items.plain_english: There, Lord Śambhu is established in the form of a liṅga.
